description_en: Mostly tibial and other limb-bone fragments. Articular surfaces are missing or broken, and bone quality is poor.
description_zh: 多為脛骨與其他肢骨殘件，關節面皆缺失或斷裂，骨質狀況差。

description_en: Fragments of parietal and frontal bone; no teeth were observed.
description_zh: 為頂骨、額骨殘件，未見有牙齒。

description_en: A pair of femora, patellae, and tibiae. Only the distal femora and proximal tibiae survive.
description_zh: 為一對股骨、髕骨與脛骨，但股骨僅剩遠端，脛骨剩近端。

description_en: A pair of tibiae. The left is more complete, with both ends present but damaged laterally; the right preserves only the shaft. Bone quality is relatively better than in the other fragmentary groups.
description_zh: 為一對脛骨，左側脛骨骨骼較為完整，兩端關節雖皆有留存，但兩端的外側都破損了，而右邊則僅存骨幹，骨質保存相對其他幾具來得佳。

description_en: A comparatively complete left femur with very poor bone quality and flaking cortex. The lesser trochanter is damaged, but the general form of both major articular ends survives.
description_zh: 擁有較完整的左側股骨骨骼，但骨質相當差，整飭過程中骨皮極易脫落。其小轉子破損，兩端主要關節都有留存大致形狀。

description_en: Poor-quality fragments, mostly from lower-limb bones; proximal and distal ends are generally missing.
description_zh: 骨質狀況差，多為下半身肢骨殘件，骨骼近、遠端多缺失。

unit: Found scattered during drainage-ditch excavation; context and burial position could not be determined
description_en: Scattered human bone found during drainage-ditch excavation; layer and burial position could not be established.
description_zh: 在水溝發掘時散落出現，無法確認出土層位與葬姿。

description_en: Both tibial and fibular shafts are identifiable, but only the shafts survive. Because the bone was extremely fragile, it was removed from the soil without washing.
description_zh: 骨質保存極差，惟兩邊脛骨及腓骨可辨認，皆僅存骨幹。又因保存狀況差，容易破碎，為了保持骨骼完整度，故沒有進行清洗，僅從土中取出。

original_interpretation_en: Fibula, femur, and tibia were reported; a pottery jar and charcoal occurred to the east. Human disturbance and secondary burial were considered possible.
reassessment_en: Probable dog burial. One package also contained a human femoral shaft and unidentified fragments; M3 may relate to M8.
original_interpretation_zh: 有腓、股、脛骨，東側有陶罐，並有炭出土，可能受過人為擾亂，不排除二次葬的可能。
reassessment_zh: 疑似犬隻墓葬；其中亦有一件人類股骨骨幹與不明骨骼碎片。

original_interpretation_en: Disturbed, poorly preserved north-south leg bones and phalanges.
reassessment_en: Cervid tibia, antler, and other cervid remains.
original_interpretation_zh: 遭人為擾動，保存狀況差，僅見南北向的腿骨和趾骨。

original_interpretation_en: Originally interpreted as the lower half of a small child in a slightly flexed side-lying position.
reassessment_en: Probable dog burial, representing the lower body; may belong to the same individual as M3.
original_interpretation_zh: 骨骼細小應為孩童，僅見下半身，依照骨盆與下肢骨走向為南北向，側身略彎曲。

original_interpretation_en: A cranium and mandible were reported, with displaced teeth in the southeast and parietal bone to the west.
reassessment_en: Unidentified fragments, probably from a small mammal.
original_interpretation_zh: 僅有一個頭骨，可見下頷骨，不過似已錯位，牙齒出現在東南角，頂骨在西側。
reassessment_zh: 不明碎骨，疑似小型哺乳類動物碎骨。

original_interpretation_en: A pelvic fragment was reported one meter south of M21 and one level above, suggesting a possible association.
reassessment_en: Small-mammal fragments including a pig tooth and pig ulna.
original_interpretation_zh: 見一個骨盆碎片，南側1m處於上一層出現M21，也許兩者有關。
reassessment_zh: 小型哺乳類動物碎骨，含有豬牙以及豬尺骨。

original_interpretation_en: Disturbed and incomplete; phalanges were northwest of the femur and the original arrangement could not be reconstructed.
reassessment_en: Mostly small-mammal remains, with some human bone. A human left foot was present, including nearly all metatarsals and most tarsals.
original_interpretation_zh: 擾動，部位不完整，見趾骨位於股骨的西北側，無法看出原貌。
reassessment_zh: 小型哺乳類動物骨骼，但見有少量人骨。

original_interpretation_en: Disturbed, with only cranial and a few possible joint fragments reported.
reassessment_en: Mostly cervid and pig fragments, with several human bones.
original_interpretation_zh: 受到擾動，僅見頭骨與少量疑似關節的部分。
reassessment_zh: 多為鹿骨、豬骨等殘片，但見有數件人骨。
